answer_1.quote: We construct a diverse benchmark comprising papers and human reviews from ICLR and NeurIPS venues, enabling both full review generation and actionable feedback comments generation assessment.
answer_1.outputs: Full review generation and actionable feedback comments

answer_2.quote: We adopt the ITF-IDF metric ... and semantic similarity‑based metrics (SN‑Precision, SN‑Recall, SN‑F1) as well as LLM‑as‑Judge scoring to evaluate the generated outputs.

answer_3.quote: We employ the LLM-as-Judge approach, leveraging the Gemini-2.5-Pro to score system‑generated reviews across multiple dimensions.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation with 20 papers randomly sampled from the test set. Five evaluators with experience reviewing for top NLP/ML conferences are recruited...
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators compare pairs of reviews or feedback comments based on criteria such as thoroughness, constructiveness, specificity (for full reviews) and accuracy, specificity, helpfulness (for feedback comments).
